scope: Blind review of RUBRIC.md and all six supplied files in each A-I folder only; no hidden condition identities inferred.

overall.recommendation: Experiment did not distinguish the anonymous executions on task correctness. Do not infer measured superiority or adopt/reject a hidden condition from this one observation per case.

ballot_selection_reason: E, H, and I all satisfy accuracy and calibration. I gives the cleanest self-contained result, with no auxiliary-policy exposition, and explicitly identifies the retained exception. It also uses the fewest reported output tokens (292 versus E 370 and H 493), consistent with the prescribed tie-break. Its wall time is not fastest.
cost_notes: Counters are copied from each metrics.json; input includes cached input.
Uncached input is computed as input minus cached input.
Reported output includes the separately reported reasoning subset; those counters are not added together.
All cache-write counters are zero. Dollar cost is unavailable; no pricing assumption made.
Tool calls and file-change calls are reported separately as supplied, without assuming disjoint categories.
blinding_limitations: Auxiliary source content is withheld; accuracy of E/H auxiliary quotations cannot be verified. They do not determine the task outcomes.
No actor checks were rerun by the judge. Executed commands/results, code diffs, and evaluator records were cross-checked.
